047.fixed_meaning: Task-scoped specialist muster only when measured task-relevant benefit is evidenced; otherwise existing role sufficient or unknown/defer. Contract generation is conditional on muster and traces 8 selected source identity/revision/scope values with normalized-input/rule reproducibility. Worker/verifier identity/context/authority separate; OS runtime/assignment/lifecycle and SECURITY authority/isolation remain external.
047.observed_cases: FV AC01 normal+single-axis negatives include unknown promoted, sufficient role ignored, provider/price/Bench-only, LABO evidence unassessed/stale/missing, comparison target/task boundary/single-worker comparison missing. AC02 includes normal source trace and six isolated missing revision references; digest/guard/contract child cases separately. AC03 has separate identity/context/authority and provider/model-only counterexamples; OS profile/lifecycle and SECURITY authority boundaries are separate. AC04 keeps unknown/defer causes and interruption/budget/deadline partial state separate, including assignment/authentication isolation.
047.assessment: No concrete false-success or false-reject defect confirmed in the covered 047 L3/L10 scope. The CASE index rows are explicitly non-counting aliases and point to underlying cases; all cited candidate authority outputs are blocked rather than inferred.

049.fixed_meaning: Measurement-only for an already-renderable, permitted prototype at selected screen/scope/revision and profile. It measures selected device/view, oracle, fixtures, text profile guidance; does not create prototype, select Pattern, issue screen ID, or move future real-user UX/drift/analytics into 1.0. No unsupported threshold or fixture-count success.
049.observed_cases: FV has 164 unique CASE rows (48 AC01, 46 AC02, 20 AC03, 15 AC04, 35 AC05): selected-scope valid measurement and unseen-in-scope normal cases; missing/unbound/revision mismatch and unknown conditions; positive/negative fixture classification and independent denominator/fixture insufficiency cases; no generation/Pattern/ID issuance requirements or outputs; text profile evidence without invented thresholds; machine pass cannot output agreement/L3 acceptance/implemented/ux_verified.
049.assessment: No concrete false-success or false-reject defect confirmed in the covered 049 L3/L10 scope. Normal unseen selected oracle conditions are not rejected solely for being unseen, while unknown out-of-scope conditions stay unknown.

054.fixed_meaning: Connection only from 047 meaning into existing OS assignment. Preserve task/scope/revision and layer×drive inputs, phase/task/oracle, selected evidence, and typed muster_candidate/existing_role_sufficient/unknown_or_defer. Mapping/enum/schema and fixed Worker count remain undefined; OS assignment/profile/lifecycle, SECURITY authority, LABO evidence applicability, INTELLIGENCE placement remain their owners.
054.observed_cases: FV has 162 unique definitions (24 numbered base rows, 38 r-series rows, and c01–c62 rows). It includes input/output source-value match for normal muster and existing-role branches; missing/stale/conflict/unknown returns; separate non-generation mutations for adoption, L3 approval, assignment, execution permission, worker start, authority and acceptance; independent same-identity/context/authority despite provider/model difference cases; layer and drive applicability-scope missing/stale/conflict/unknown each isolated (c55–c62). Index rows point to independent child cases and are not counted as independent mutations.
054.assessment: No concrete false-success or false-reject defect confirmed in the covered 054 L3/L10 scope. The cases distinguish known responsibility category from unknown individual identity and send normal HARNESS output errors back to HARNESS rather than misrouting them as missing upstream authority.
